features: Lovely One Bedroom Barrel-Vaulted Ceiling Apartment
Great Transport Links including Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Lovely barrel-vaulted ceiling one-bedroom split level apartment, larger than average. Located on the top floor (9th). Beautifully presented. Wood flooring throughout the reception/kitchen. In the hallway is a large cupboard for coats etc. Additional W.C. downstairs. Quiet location in the heart of the Barbican art centre overlooking the sculpture court. 3 lifts. Use of residents’ gardens. 24hr car park attendants can hold keys and receive packages. Car parking and bike storage by separate negotiation with the City of London. The Barbican Estate includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatre, restaurants, bars and cafes. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are close at hand. The Barbican is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations only a short walk away. Also, in close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, St. Paul’s, and Moorgate. No onward chain.
Service Charge: Estimated: £4,336. 01/04/25 to 31/03/26
Lease: 150 years from 2010
Ground Rent: £150 per annum
